name: User Crontab Replaced (Linux)
description: A user crontab was replaced via `crontab -` (syslog: 'REPLACE'). Cron is a durable persistence mechanism. NOTE: the cron daemon logs the *action*, not the command body, so this rule cannot see the payload — that requires file-integrity monitoring of /var/spool/cron and /etc/cron.d (auditd / Elastic Defend). Treat as a medium-priority lead and pull the crontab during triage.
query: event.dataset:"system.syslog" and process.name:"crontab" and message:("REPLACE" or "REWRITE")
false_positives: Deployment tooling and users legitimately editing their crontab.
High volume expected on shared hosts — raise severity only with corroborating signal (a preceding SSH brute-force success, a new account).
note:
### Triage
- `crontab -l -u <user>` on the host — read the actual entries.
- Resolve any callback host and check `logs-network_traffic.*` for beacons.
- Correlate with `soc-linux-ssh-bruteforce-success` / `soc-linux-new-local-user` on the same host.
